notes: REF-BM-02: only <title> is auto-collected (titleFetcher.js/links.js extractTitle); no description, favicon, or preview image are fetched or stored. REF-BM-03: title can be edited after save via rename (app.js startRename); no pre-save edit step and no description field exists at all. REF-BM-04: only title is editable (PATCH /api/bookmarks/:id in app.js sets title only); url, description, tags, note are not editable (none of those fields exist on the record in store.js). REF-BM-06: duplicate POST returns the existing bookmark and highlights/flashes it (app.js doSave, src/app.js handleApi) rather than creating a copy, but it does not open an edit affordance — user is shown the existing item, not put into an edit flow. REF-BM-07: list rows show only title and url (public/app.js renderRow); no description, tags, or favicon fields exist in the Bookmark record (store.js add()). REF-BM-09/10/11: no tag field, tag storage, autocomplete, or tag filter anywhere in src/ or public/. REF-BM-12: search (public/search.js matches()) checks only title and url substrings; no description/note fields exist to search, and note/description aren't part of the schema. REF-BM-14/15/16: search.js implements plain case-insensitive substring matching only — no #tag syntax, no AND/OR/NOT/parentheses parsing, no quoted-phrase handling (confirmed via test/search.test.js which only tests substring matches). REF-BM-17/18/19: no unread/read flag or field anywhere in store.js records or the API. REF-BM-20/21: UI/API only support single-item rename/delete (src/app.js), no multi-select or bulk endpoints. REF-BM-22: list is always newest-first (store.js unshift on add); no sort key or sort UI. REF-BM-23: no note field or markdown rendering anywhere. REF-BM-24/25: no snapshot/archival mechanism, no PDF handling, no Internet Archive integration. REF-BM-26/27/28: no archive flag, no archive/delete distinction (only hard delete with undo), no archive view. REF-BM-29: no bundle entity or saved-filter mechanism. REF-BM-30/31: no Netscape HTML import/export code paths. REF-BM-32: no settings entity or UI for sort/page-size/font-size.
